description: Structured repair specification sent from C2 to C3. Contains the diagnosed root cause and affected subgroup definition that C3 uses to generate targeted synthetic repair data.

root_cause_feature.description: Top-ranked feature identified as primary root cause by temporal SHAP analysis.

root_cause_category.description: Category of root cause matching C1 drift_type classification.

affected_slice_rule.description: Queryable rule defining the failing data subgroup. Must be a valid pandas DataFrame.query() string. C3 applies this rule to reference data to extract the repair target population.

affected_features_ranked.description: Features ranked by Drift Impact Score contribution. C3 uses this to weight synthetic data generation toward the most impactful features.

affected_value_ranges.description: Specific value ranges within root cause features defining the affected subgroup. Keys are feature names, values are [min, max] for continuous or list of values for categorical.

slice_support.description: Fraction of production data falling within the affected slice. C3 uses this to determine synthetic data quantity. slice_support * len(reference_df) gives approximate affected row count.

diagnosis_stability.description: Confidence score of the diagnosis based on temporal SHAP consistency across monitoring cycles. High stability (>0.8) means diagnosis is reliable. C3 uses this to decide repair aggressiveness.

drift_impact_score.description: Fused score combining drift magnitude, SHAP value change, and performance impact. C3 uses this to scale repair quantity via the Repair Prescription Engine.

temporal_window.description: Number of monitoring cycles over which the diagnosis was stable. Higher values indicate a more persistent and reliable diagnosis.

notes: affected_slice_rule must be a valid pandas DataFrame.query() string
C3 applies affected_slice_rule to reference_df to get the repair target population
If diagnosis_stability < 0.5, C3 should apply conservative repair (smaller augmentation ratio)
slice_support * len(reference_df) gives approximate number of affected rows
drift_impact_score is a C2 novelty: NOT the same as drift_severity from C1
During independent development, Mathusan derives these values from injection ground truth and varies diagnosis_stability as a training parameter (range 0.3 to 0.95)
